rules.statement: The Ceylon Land Tenures Ordinance does not require a justa causa or just title for adverse possession to be valid, as this doctrine was not recognized in Ceylon at the time of the Ordinance's passing.
rules.supporting_quote: "This opinion does not rest solely upon the words enclosed in brackets by way of explanation nr definition- �(that is to say, a possession . . . . inferred)� but is supported also by the absence of any words calculated to define or assert the special doctrine of justa causa."
